about: Proposed Lean Factory configuration for Mira. Owner-only: Factory never merges a change to this file.

issueGates.about: Provisional: a fixed common folder until Mira agrees how an issue names its lane. The full unit suite runs as a beta gate.

release.about: tools/ship.sh exits 0 even when a release fails; it reports through /tmp/mira-ship-N.done. Factory therefore decides success only from the verify steps, which read what beta.mira.cc and mira.cc actually serve, the way tools/release.sh verifies: the served build.json id and version must name the frozen copy, and tools/frozen-versions.mjs check must pass against it.

artifact.about: Frozen copies are checked by the daemon itself, as a pure read: every file and symlink of ../Syn3h-stable/<id> except .wrangler (wrangler's own scratch state), plus where its node_modules link resolves and that directory's installed lockfile.

guard.about: Read-only. Refuses when the next release number or version already appears in Syn3h-stable, which means Mira released something the origin does not show yet.
guard.run:
set -eu
if [ -n "${VORTEO_RELEASE_NUMBER:-}" ] && cut -f1 ../Syn3h-stable/releases.tsv | grep -qx "release-$VORTEO_RELEASE_NUMBER"; then echo "release-$VORTEO_RELEASE_NUMBER is already recorded in Syn3h-stable" >&2; exit 3; fi
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const v=process.argv[1]||"";if(!v)process.exit(0);const root="../Syn3h-stable";const bare=v.replace(/^v/,"");if(fs.existsSync(p.join(root,"versions",bare))){console.error(v+" is archived in Syn3h-stable");process.exit(3)}const approvals=fs.existsSync(p.join(root,"approvals.tsv"))?fs.readFileSync(p.join(root,"approvals.tsv"),"utf8").split("\n").map((l)=>l.split("\t")[0]):[];if(approvals.includes(v)){console.error(v+" is approved in Syn3h-stable");process.exit(3)}for(const d of fs.readdirSync(root)){try{if(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(root,d,"dist","build.json"),"utf8")).version===v){console.error(v+" is already frozen as "+d);process.exit(3)}}catch{}}' "${VORTEO_RELEASE_VERSION:-}"

releaseNumber.about: Read-only. The next release-N after every release recorded in ../Syn3h-stable/releases.tsv and every release-N tag.
releaseNumber.run:
last="$( { cut -f1 ../Syn3h-stable/releases.tsv 2>/dev/null; git tag -l 'release-*'; } | sed -n 's/^release-\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' | sort -n | tail -1)"
printf '{"number":"%s"}\n' "$(( ${last:-0} + 1 ))"

verifyBeta.about: Read-only. The newest betas.tsv row must be the accepted commit, and beta.mira.cc must serve exactly that frozen copy.
verifyBeta.run:
set -eu
row="$(grep -v '^#' release-notes/betas.tsv | tail -1)"
version="$(printf '%s' "$row" | cut -f1)"
commit="$(git rev-parse --verify "$(printf '%s' "$row" | cut -f3)^0")"
frozen="$(printf '%s' "$row" | cut -f5)"
served="$(curl -sf --max-time 15 https://beta.mira.cc/build.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",(d)=>(s+=d)).on("end",()=>{const b=JSON.parse(s);process.stdout.write(b.id+" "+b.version)})')"
[ "$served" = "$frozen $version" ] || { echo "beta.mira.cc serves $served, not $frozen $version" >&2; exit 1; }
node tools/frozen-versions.mjs check https://beta.mira.cc/ "../Syn3h-stable/$frozen" >&2
printf '{"version":"%s","commit":"%s","artifact":"%s"}\n' "$version" "$commit" "$frozen"

verifyStable.about: Read-only. mira.cc must serve the frozen copy being promoted or restored, at that copy's own version.
verifyStable.run:
set -eu
frozen="../Syn3h-stable/$VORTEO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT"
version="$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")).version)' "$frozen/dist/build.json")"
served="$(curl -sf --max-time 15 https://mira.cc/build.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",(d)=>(s+=d)).on("end",()=>{const b=JSON.parse(s);process.stdout.write(b.id+" "+b.version)})')"
[ "$served" = "$VORTEO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT $version" ] || { echo "mira.cc serves $served, not $VORTEO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT $version" >&2; exit 1; }
node tools/frozen-versions.mjs check https://mira.cc/ "$frozen" >&2
printf '{"version":"%s","commit":null,"artifact":"%s"}\n' "$version" "$VORTEO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT"

stable.name: browser checks
stable.about: macOS WebGPU suites: Host only, after review and the owner-only gate. The delivery checkout's own tools/heavy.sh holds one shared slot for up to an hour.
